title: Children's Constitution Club — Session 2

slides.title: Session 2 — Naming of Club & Launch Campaign
Welcome to the Children's Constitution Club!
Welcome back!
body: Hey and welcome back to another session at CMCA!
Can you quickly check to see if you are all sitting in your groups?
How about we give our club a name today?

slides.title: Name your Club!
body: Make sure your names are impactful and speak citizenship!
It should also equally motivate you.
slides.callout: Teacher's Tip: Write down the suggestions on the class board.

slides.title: What is your Club Name?
body: You have 1 vote per person for 1 name. Choose wisely.
Be fair — only raise your hand if you like the name!
The name with the highest votes will be selected as your club name.

slides.title: And… your Club Name is…?
body: ______________ Children's Constitution Club!
And YOU have the power to bring about CHANGE!

slides.title: Ripples of Change
body: So many children like you are Active Citizens today, making so many ripples of change!
But… with power comes responsibility.

slides.title: Master Change Appears
slides.transcript: Hello junior citizens, Namaskara! I am back for another session with you! Now that you have selected your group name, you have one more step to do. Just like a parliament in the nation or even the student council in your school, we will have our own committee! And we are going to do that together. You will see Democracy in Action! How do we choose our leaders in India? (pause for responses) Yes — we have elections at different levels: Gram Panchayat, Vidhan Sabha, Lok Sabha.

slides.title: What makes an ideal representative?
slides.transcript: Before we move on to electing, what makes an ideal representative? What are some of the qualities they need? (pause for responses) — (Q1) If your friend and another student are candidates, and you know that the other student may do the job better — who will you vote for? (Q2) Would it matter if the job was done by a girl or a boy? (Q3) How will you feel if your friends didn't vote for you? (Q4) What if you stand for elections but don't win? What will your attitude be towards the winner?

slides.title: Let's get our committee ready!
slides.brief: Your first step is to elect one person from your group to be part of the core committee of the club. You have 2 minutes!

slides.title: Let's get our committee ready!
body: Good Job! Now all the selected members come in front of the class.
Who would like to stand as the Club President? Step forward.
You have 1 minute to tell the club why they should elect you!

slides.title: Committee in front
body: Selected members stand in front of the class and pitch.

slides.title: Assertive Action
body: Do you think this is okay? Rethink if your class is in this same situation!

slides.title: Assertive Action — Visual
body: (Affirmative action illustration)

slides.title: Let's Vote Now!
body: Who will be our Club President?
You have 1 vote.
slides.callout: Teacher's Tip: Ask the elected children to turn back. The rest close their eyes and vote by showing their hands. Take the total count, announce and congratulate.

slides.title: Congratulations!
body: Congratulations to our President and Core Committee!
Now is the time for all our hands to get to work!
slides.callout: Teacher's Tip: If it gets unmanageable, use calmers!

slides.title: What is a campaign?
slides.transcript: What you see is a campaign! A campaign is like a big, exciting team mission to reach a specific goal or to educate people about a topic. It is when you make a smart plan, gather your tools, and work together to win a prize or solve a big problem! Let us spread the cheer all around now! We will be doing a CMCA Club Launch Campaign — during one of your school assemblies! (Yaaaaaayyyy! Cheers by children!)

slides.title: Campaign image bank
body: (Campaign images)

slides.title: CMCA Club Launch
body: You have two options!
slides.callout: Option A vs Option B — two graphic panels side-by-side. Children pick one and execute offline. NO on-screen choice.

slides.title: The success of the launch
body: The campaign you would be doing is about the importance of diverse culture in our country.
There are many roles to be taken up for the success of the launch — especially the Club President and the Core Committee.
The success of the launch is in your hands!

slides.title: You'll receive prints
body: You will receive prints to help support this process! Each group will get one set of prints.
Sit together and discuss how best we can make our school aware of our club.
The magic is in your hands!
slides.callout: Teacher's Tip: Distribute the annexures to the groups. Core Committee takes the lead for the launch.

slides.title: Master Change signs off
slides.transcript: Hey Friends. I see you are all getting ready to help your school know about your club. This is your opportunity to let everyone know that you are a part of an important mission and that you need the school's support too! Have fun. Plan well. Wishing you all the very best! I am excited to watch this club launch already! BYEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE! (waving hands)
slides.closing_line: Today our Constitution Club journey has taken another important step. See you again in the next session.

slides.closing_line: Today our Constitution Club journey has taken another important step. See you again in the next session.
